items.title: 21.4 Halogenoalkanes ke reactions ki misalein (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the reactions of halogenoalkanes (PDF 82-84).

blocks.text: Hydroxide ion achha nucleophile bhi hai aur achha base bhi, is liye halogenoalkane halaat ke mutabiq substitution ya elimination products de sakta hai. Reactions urne wale products zaya hone se bachane ke liye reflux par zyada darja hararat par kiye jate hain. Bromoethane aabi sodium hydroxide se ethanol aur ethanol mein sodium hydroxide se ethene deta hai:

blocks.alt: Darmiyan mein bromoethane, CH3CH2Br, aur paanch teer. NaOH(aq) aur garmi: ethanol, CH3CH2OH + NaBr (substitution). Ethanol mein NaOH aur garmi: ethene, CH2=CH2 + H2O + NaBr (elimination). Ethanol mein KCN, reflux: propanenitrile, CH3CH2CN + KBr (substitution). Ethanol mein NH3, garmi aur pressure: ethylamine, CH3CH2NH2 + HBr (substitution). Paani aur ethanol mein AgNO3: Br- + Ag+ se AgBr ka cream rang ka precipitate (rasoob), jo bromine ki nishani hai.
blocks.caption: Bromoethane ke reactions (kitab ki likhi equations ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Paani mein hydroxide ion nucleophile ki tarah kaam karta aur alcohol deta, lekin ethanol mein base ki tarah aur alkene deta. Cyanide ion aur ammonia nucleophiles hain: cyanide zanjeer mein aik carbon barhata (nitrile), ammonia amine deta. Silver nitrate carbon ki zanjeer nahi badalta; silver bromide ka cream precipitate compound mein bromine ka test hai.

items: Elimination (ethanol mein): CH3CH2Br + NaOH -> CH2=CH2 + H2O + NaBr

blocks.text: Cyanide ion taqatwar nucleophile lekin kamzor base hai, is liye substitution deta hai: nitrile. Halogenoalkane ko ethanol mein potassium cyanide ke saath reflux par garam kiya jata hai. Bromoethane propanenitrile deta hai, jis mein aik carbon atom zyada hai: CH3CH2Br + KCN -> CH3CH2CN + KBr.

Ammonia achha nucleophile hai aur ethanol mein pressure ke saath garam kiye gaye halogenoalkanes se react karti hai: C2H5Br + NH3 -> C2H5NH2 (ethylamine, ethanamine) + HBr. Banne wala amine khud nucleophile hai aur ammonia se muqabla karta hai, is liye mazeed substitution se N-ethylethanamine, (C2H5)2NH, phir N,N-diethylethanamine, (C2H5)3N, bante hain. Bromoethane ki bohat zyada miqdar se aakhri product quaternary ammonium namak, tetraethylammonium bromide, (C2H5)4N+ Br-, hai. Miqdaron ko ehtiyat se qabu kar ke mukhtalif amines hasil kiye ja sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Dabbon ki seerhi: NH3 (ammonia), C2H5NH2 (ethanamine, primary amine), (C2H5)2NH (N-ethylethanamine, secondary), (C2H5)3N (N,N-diethylethanamine, tertiary) aur (C2H5)4N+ Br- (tetraethylammonium bromide, quaternary namak), har qadam par + C2H5Br.
blocks.caption: Bromoethane se ammonia ki silsilewar substitution (kitab ke mua'adlon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har amine ke nitrogen par ab bhi lone pair hai, is liye woh aik aur bromoethane molecule par hamla kar sakta hai. Har qadam par aik ethyl group lagta hai yahan tak ke nitrogen par chaar ethyl groups aur musbat charge ho jata hai.

blocks.text: IV. Aabi silver nitrate ke saath

Reaction paani aur ethanol ke mixture mein kiya jata hai; ethanol halogenoalkane ko ghulne mein madad deta hai. Paani nucleophile ka kaam kar ke halogen ki jagah leta hai: CH3CH2X + H2O -> CH3CH2OH + H+ + X-. Nikalne wala halide ion phir silver nitrate se react kar ke precipitate deta hai jis ka rang batata hai ke kaun sa halogen tha.

blocks.alt: Aabi ethanolic silver nitrate ki teen test tubes: chloroalkane AgCl ka safaid precipitate dheere, bromoalkane AgBr ka cream precipitate tez, aur iodoalkane AgI ka peela precipitate sab se tez deta hai. Neeche: R-X + H2O -> R-OH + H+ + X-.
blocks.caption: Silver nitrate se halogen ki pehchan (is reaction ke liye asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Precipitate ka rang halogen ki pehchan karata hai, aur jis raftaar se woh nazar aata hai woh halogenoalkane ki reactivity dikhati hai: C-X bond jitna kamzor, paani utni tezi se halogen ki jagah leta hai. Iodoalkanes bohat jaldi, bromoalkanes dheere aur chloroalkanes bohat dheere precipitate dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Halogenoalkanes ko organic compounds ki bohat reactive qism kyun samjha jata hai?
blocks.explanation: C-X bond polar hai, is liye carbon electrophilic aur nucleophiles ka nishana hai; halide ion achha leaving group hai; aur C-Cl, C-Br aur C-I bonds C-H se kamzor hain. Bases HX hata kar alkenes bhi de sakte hain.
CH3COOC2H5 (ethyl ethanoate) + NaBr: ethanoate ion nucleophile ka kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethane ko ethanol aur ethene mein kaise badlenge?
blocks.explanation: Roshni mein ethane + Cl2 se chloroethane. Chloroethane ko aabi NaOH ke saath garam karne se ethanol; ethanol mein NaOH ke saath garam karne se ethene.

blocks.prompt: 1-bromopropane ka KCN se reaction batayein. Yeh substitution hai ya elimination? Product ka naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: CH3CH2CH2Br + KCN -> CH3CH2CH2CN + KBr (ethanol mein, reflux). Yeh nucleophilic substitution hai; product butanenitrile hai.

items: NaOH(aq): alcohol (substitution); ethanol mein NaOH: alkene (elimination).
Ethanol mein KCN: aik zyada C wala nitrile; NH3: amines, aakhir mein quaternary namak.
AgNO3(aq, ethanol): AgCl safaid, AgBr cream, AgI peela; kamzor C-X ke liye tez.
